notes: IEEE 802.3df does not define OTP/fuse content as a protocol concept. 800G endpoints store the 48-bit MAC in non-volatile memory; PHY identity lives in the Clause-45 PMA/PMD identifier registers; pluggable-module identity is in the CMIS module EEPROM. SerDes/FEC analog trim is vendor OTP.

otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.note: Per-device Universally Administered MAC from the vendor OUI; I/G=0, U/L=0.
Vendor OUI + model + revision in the Clause-45 PMA/PMD identifier registers (no Clause-22 PHY ID at 800G).
OSFP / QSFP-DD800 module type, supported 800GBASE PMD variant, vendor + serial — read over the module two-wire interface, not part of 802.3df itself.

otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.field: SerDes / FEC trim + default equaliser presets
otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.note: Per-lane analog trim + default FFE/DFE presets locked at production; vendor-specific.
